correctness.rationale: Unitary per-ring DFT and descending Fourier-order elimination block-triangularize the square collocation matrix. Each order block equals associated Legendre leading coefficient product times row sin-powers and latitude Vandermonde. Multiplicity counts yield 2i+1 in each separation and k(k+1)/2 in each (1-x_k²). Strict log concavity and boundary decay give a unique interior extremum per latitude-order chamber. At L=3, exact elimination of two polynomial stationary equations gives exactly two admissible radical solutions, and a positive exact rational comparison selects the global maximum. Standard-library reproduction directly evaluates spherical harmonic matrices and exact quadratic-field identities. Infinite bandwidth is proved by analytic factorization, not sampled experiments.

value.rationale: Information-volume/D-optimal design is a motivated exact invariant for the critical L²-sample spherical Fourier acquisition. The finding gives an all-bandwidth factorization and structural per-chamber uniqueness, and a sharp nine-sample design addressing the first nontrivial three/five latitude allocation beyond the classical one/three pole case. The resulting approximately six-percent absolute determinant improvement relative to equiangular sampling is interpretable for this precise objective; no unrelated downstream stability claim is made.
